class LolGetChampionAnalysis: data
class Data: summary,damage_type,strong_counters,weak_counters,runes,trends
class Summary: average_stats
class AverageStats: play,win_rate,pick_rate,ban_rate,tier,rank
class StrongCounter: champion_name,play,win,my_win_rate,counter_win_rate
class Runes: primary_page_id,primary_rune_ids,secondary_page_id,secondary_rune_ids,stat_mod_ids,play,win,pick_rate
class Trends: win
class Win: version
